question: What is the overall financial health score of the school based on revenue vs. operational expenditure this year?
sql_text: SELECT (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(fc.Receipt_Amt), 0) FROM FeesCollection fc WHERE fc.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND fc.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND (fc.IsDeleted IS NULL OR fc.IsDeleted = 0) AND fc.ChequeStatus_ID NOT IN (3, 4)) AS TotalRevenue, (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(gem.NetPay), 0) FROM GenerateSalaryEmployee_Master gem INNER JOIN GenerateSalary_Master gm ON gem.HeaderID = gm.ID WHERE gm.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND gm.IsDeleted = 0 AND gem.IsDeleted = 0 AND gm.MonthID = (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, Start_Date, GETDATE()) + 1 FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id = gm.BranchID)) AS TotalSalaryExpenses

question: Is our UDISE+ data fully updated and ready for the current year's submission deadline?
sql_text: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Not all sections have data' ELSE 'All sections complete' END AS Status FROM (SELECT sad.ClassID, secm.Name AS SectionName FROM StudentAcademicDetail sad INNER JOIN SectionMaster secm ON sad.SectionID = secm.ID WHERE sad.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND sad.IsActive = 1 GROUP BY sad.ClassID, secm.Name HAVING COUNT(*) < 2) t

question: What is the monthly expenditure on classroom consumables (chalk, markers, stationery, printer ink)?
sql_text: SELECT SUM(gem.NetPay) AS TotalSalary FROM GenerateSalaryEmployee_Master gem INNER JOIN GenerateSalary_Master gm ON gem.HeaderID = gm.ID WHERE gm.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND gm.IsDeleted = 0 AND gem.IsDeleted = 0 AND gm.MonthID = (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, Start_Date, GETDATE()) + 1 FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id = gm.BranchID)

question: What is the total pending transport fee collection from parents?
sql_text: SELECT SUM(f.Amount - ISNULL(f.Concession_Amt, 0) - ISNULL(f.Paid_Amt, 0) - ISNULL(f.Lien_Amount, 0)) AS TransportOutstanding FROM FeesInformationStudentDetail f INNER JOIN StudentAcademicDetail sa ON f.Student_ID = sa.StudentID AND f.ClassID = sa.ClassID WHERE f.IsIncludedInLumpSum <> 1 AND f.IsDonation = 0 AND f.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND f.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND f.IsBusFee = 1 AND sa.IsActive = 1 AND (sa.IsTCIssued = 0 OR sa.IsTCIssued IS NULL)

question: How many students are currently availing the school transport facility?
sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TransportStudents FROM StudentAcademicDetail sad WHERE sad.TransportRequired = 1 AND sad.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND sad.IsActive = 1 AND (sad.IsTCIssued = 0 OR sad.IsTCIssued IS NULL)

question: How many teachers are currently pursuing higher education (e.g., B.Ed., M.A.) as per HR records?
sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TeachersInHigherEd FROM Staff_Master sm INNER JOIN StaffDesignationMaster sdm ON sm.Designation_ID = sdm.ID WHERE sm.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND sm.IsDeleted = 0 AND sm.StaffStatus_ID = 1 AND sdm.Name LIKE '%Education%'

question: What is the headcount distribution of staff across different departments (admin, academic, support)?
sql_text: SELECT dm.Name AS Department, COUNT(sm.Staff_ID) AS StaffCount FROM StaffDepartmentMaster dm INNER JOIN StaffDepartmentMapping sdm ON dm.Id = sdm.DepartmentID INNER JOIN StaffDepartmentMappingDetail sdmd ON sdm.Id = sdmd.MappingID INNER JOIN Staff_Master sm ON sdmd.StaffID = sm.Staff_ID WHERE dm.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND (dm.IsDeleted IS NULL OR dm.IsDeleted = 0) AND (sm.IsDeleted IS NULL OR sm.IsDeleted = 0) AND sm.StaffStatus_ID = 1 GROUP BY dm.Name ORDER BY StaffCount DESC

question: How many staff grievances or HR complaints are currently unresolved?
sql_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS UnresolvedComplaints FROM FeedbackTicket WHERE BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND (IsDeleted = 0 OR IsDeleted IS NULL) AND Status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Reopened')

question: What is the total monthly payroll expense, including statutory deductions (PF, ESI, Professional Tax)?
sql_text: SELECT SUM(gem.NetPay) AS TotalMonthlyPayroll FROM GenerateSalaryEmployee_Master gem INNER JOIN GenerateSalary_Master gm ON gem.HeaderID = gm.ID WHERE gm.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND gm.IsDeleted = 0 AND gem.IsDeleted = 0 AND gm.MonthID = (SELECT DATEDIFF(MONTH, Start_Date, GETDATE()) + 1 FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id = gm.BranchID)

question: Can you generate a subject-wise weakness report for Class 9 Mathematics?
sql_text: SELECT pc.SubjectName AS SubjectName, CAST(AVG(pc.Marks) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS AvgMarks FROM ProgressCardDataRetrieval pc INNER JOIN ClassMaster cm ON pc.ClassID = cm.ID WHERE cm.Name IN ('Class 9', 'IX') AND pc.SubjectName = 'Mathematics' AND (pc.Others IS NULL OR pc.Others NOT IN ('NA', 'NT', 'OP')) AND pc.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND pc.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND (pc.IsDeleted = 0 OR pc.IsDeleted IS NULL) GROUP BY pc.SubjectName ORDER BY AvgMarks ASC

question: Which teachers' classes show the most significant improvement in test scores compared to last term?

question: Can you identify the top 10 academic performers in each class for the current term?
sql_text: SELECT cm.Name AS ClassName, TOP 10 pc.StudentName AS StudentName, pc.Marks, pc.MaxMarks, pc.AdmissionNo, secm.Name AS SectionName FROM ProgressCardDataRetrieval pc INNER JOIN ClassMaster cm ON pc.ClassID = cm.ID JOIN SectionMaster secm ON pc.SectionID = secm.ID WHERE pc.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND pc.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND (pc.IsDeleted = 0 OR pc.IsDeleted IS NULL) AND pc.SubjectTypeID = 1 ORDER BY cm.DisplayOrder, pc.Marks DESC

question: Which subject has the highest number of students scoring below 33% in Class 10?
sql_text: SELECT TOP 1 pc.SubjectName AS SubjectName, COUNT(*) AS BelowPass FROM ProgressCardDataRetrieval pc INNER JOIN ClassMaster cm ON pc.ClassID = cm.ID WHERE (pc.Marks < pc.MinMark OR pc.Others = 'AB') AND cm.Name IN ('Class 10', 'X') AND pc.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND pc.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) AND (pc.IsDeleted = 0 OR pc.IsDeleted IS NULL) GROUP BY pc.SubjectName ORDER BY BelowPass DESC

question: What is the overall pass percentage for the recent half-yearly/term examinations?
sql_text: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN smd.Marks >= eced.MinMark AND (smd.Others IS NULL OR smd.Others <> 'AB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS PassPercentage FROM StudentMarkDetails smd INNER JOIN ExamConfigurationEvaluationDetails eced ON smd.EvalHierID = eced.ID INNER JOIN StudentMarkMaster smm ON smd.HeaderID = smm.ID WHERE smd.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND smd.Deleted = 0 AND smm.Deleted = 0

question: What is the average attendance rate for students actively participating in extracurricular activities?

question: Can you generate an alert list of students whose cumulative attendance has dropped below 75%?
sql_text: SELECT sm.AdmissionNo, ISNULL(sm.FirstName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(sm.MiddleName, '') + ' ' + ISNULL(sm.LastName, '') AS StudentName, cm.Name AS ClassName, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.Attendance_Status_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS AttendancePercent FROM StudentAttendance sa INNER JOIN Student_Master sm ON sa.Student_ID = sm.ID INNER JOIN StudentAcademicDetail sad ON sa.Student_ID = sad.StudentID AND sad.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN ClassMaster cm ON sad.ClassID = cm.ID WHERE sa.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND sa.AcademicYearID IN (SELECT Id FROM Branch_Academic_Details WHERE GETDATE() BETWEEN Start_Date AND End_Date AND Branch_Id IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0))) GROUP BY sm.AdmissionNo, sm.FirstName, sm.MiddleName, sm.LastName, cm.Name HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.Attendance_Status_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) < 75 ORDER BY AttendancePercent

question: How many substitute teachers were required this week due to regular staff absenteeism?

question: What is the correlation between low attendance and poor academic performance in Class 10?
sql_text: SELECT CAST(AVG(smd.Marks) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS AvgMarks, CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.Attendance_Status_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS AttendancePercent FROM StudentMarkDetails smd INNER JOIN StudentMarkMaster smm ON smd.HeaderID = smm.ID INNER JOIN StudentAttendance sa ON smd.StudentID = sa.Student_ID AND sa.Class_ID = smm.ClassID INNER JOIN ClassMaster c ON smm.ClassID = c.ID WHERE smd.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) AND smd.Deleted = 0 AND (smd.Others IS NULL OR smd.Others NOT IN ('NA', 'NT', 'OP')) AND smm.Deleted = 0 AND c.Name = 'Class 10'

question: How many late-coming instances were recorded this week, and in which classes?
sql_text: SELECT cm.Name AS ClassName, COUNT(*) AS LateInstances FROM StudentAttendance sa INNER JOIN ClassMaster cm ON sa.Class_ID = cm.ID WHERE sa.Attendance_Status_ID = 4 AND sa.Attendance_Date >= DATEADD(DAY, -DATEPART(WEEKDAY, GETDATE()) + 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) AND sa.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) GROUP BY cm.Name ORDER BY LateInstances DESC

question: What is the teacher and non-teaching staff attendance percentage today?
sql_text: SELECT CASE WHEN stcm.Name = 'Teaching' THEN 'Teacher' ELSE 'Non-Teaching' END AS StaffType, CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.Attendance_Status_ID = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS AttendancePercent FROM Staff_Attendance sa INNER JOIN Staff_Master sm ON sa.Staff_ID = sm.Staff_ID AND sm.StaffStatus_ID = 1 INNER JOIN StaffType_Master stm ON sm.StaffType_ID = stm.ID INNER JOIN StaffTypeCategoryMaster stcm ON stm.Type_Id = stcm.Id WHERE CAST(sa.Attendance_Date AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) AND sa.BranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM UserAccountRoleDetails WHERE UserID = @UserId AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR BranchID = @SelectedBranchId) UNION SELECT ID FROM BranchMaster WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UserAccountMaster WHERE ID = @UserId AND IsSuperUser = 1) AND (@SelectedBranchId IS NULL OR ID = @SelectedBranchId) AND (IsDeleted IS NULL OR IsDeleted = 0)) GROUP BY CASE WHEN stcm.Name = 'Teaching' THEN 'Teacher' ELSE 'Non-Teaching' END

question: Which class or section has the lowest attendance rate this month?

question: What is the overall average student attendance percentage for this week?

question: What is the projected student strength for the next academic year based on current promotion data?

question: What is the overall gender ratio (boys vs. girls) across the school?
